checks: Product cards remain readable and scannable.
Search and collection contexts use consistent card language.
No stock Trade placeholder copy remains on included surfaces.
journeys.expectedResult: Customers can discover products without layout overlap, misleading badges, or placeholder copy.

journeys.customerState: buyer evaluating price, quantity, variants, and add-to-cart action
checks: Title, price, quantity, variant controls, primary purchase action, and support links wrap correctly.
Focus, loading, disabled, and error states are visible and understandable.

checks: Cart notification or cart page shows the expected product, quantity, price, and recovery actions.
Quantity update and removal controls remain keyboard reachable.

journeys.expectedResult: Cart state is stable and purchase progression remains intact.

journeys.customerState: customer seeking help before or after purchase
checks: Contact form labels and errors are usable.
Support, repair, warranty administration, and entity-role claims are reviewed before publication.
journeys.expectedResult: Support surfaces are reachable, accessible, and free of unapproved responsibility claims.

checks: Policy pages remain readable at mobile and desktop widths.

manualChecks.passCriteria: All interactive controls are reachable and operable without a pointer.
Content remains readable and controls remain usable at 200 percent zoom.
Increased text spacing does not overlap, clip, or hide content.
Decorative motion is removed or minimized and state changes remain understandable.
Focus, controls, and required content remain visible in forced-colors mode.
Product and identity imagery does not hide important product or logo details.
No stock Trade placeholder text remains on Epic B included surfaces.
Blocked legal, warranty, certification, patent, supplier, freight, and support claims do not appear.
Rhino logo and mark remain legible and are not altered from approved assets.
Focus ring and focus halo are visible without relying only on color.
Each page has a clear main heading and logical heading order.

evidence: screenshots at mobile-360, mobile-390, and desktop-1440

Preview settings survive pull/push workflow and production settings remain unchanged.
